narr: Scattered showers and thunderstorms developed across Middle Tennessee during the afternoon and evening hours on June 2nd. A few storms became severe with damaging winds and minor flash flooding.
ev: Heavy rains caused flooding in multiple mobile homes in Dover. In addition, two people were swept away in a car and rescued, and another two people were stranded in a vehicle stuck in high water. Time approximated from radar.
lsr: HEAVY RAINS CAUSED WATER IN MULTIPLE MOBILE HOMES, 2 PEOPLE SWEPT AWAY IN CAR AND ANOTHER 2 STRANDED DUE TO HIGH WATER. TIME APPROXIMATED FROM RADAR.
